query: NEC 690.11 dc arc-fault circuit protection PV 80 volts listed AFCI

results.query: NEC 690.11 dc arc-fault circuit protection PV 80 volts listed AFCI
results.snippet: NEC Section 690.11 requires that any PV system with an operating voltage of 80 V dc or greater between any two conductors shall be protected with a listed arc-fault circuit interrupter or other equivalent equipment.
results.title: Fire and Personnel Safety Requirements for Photovoltaic Systems (IAEI Magazine, John Wiles, May 2022)
